name: lean-ctx
description: Inspect LeanCTX, the Context Gateway for AI Systems: recorded context activity, redactions and command-policy decisions, with editor-assisted checks of code relationships.

leanctx.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `lean-ctx` binary. Empty: look on `PATH` and in the usual install locations.

leanctx.statusBar.enabled.markdownDescription: Show what lean-ctx did in this project in the status bar. `value_display.mode = "off"` in the lean-ctx config hides it as well.

leanctx.semanticBridge.enabled.markdownDescription: Let lean-ctx ask this editor's language features (go to definition, references, implementations, type hierarchy) to verify code relationships in its graph. Read-only, served on `127.0.0.1` behind a per-window token; nothing leaves the machine.
